label: The virus is sent to derail the revival
description: That the outbreak and the fear around it were intended to derail the revival that is about to take place, with people alarmed while others, including in China, were not taking it seriously.
aliases: this was to derail the the revival that's about to take

label: A two term president is coming
description: Given while praying over the vice president and the secretary of state and saying the Lord is holding the church accountable for how they pray for the president: that he saw a two term president coming.
aliases: I saw a two-term president coming
I'm holding the church accountable how you pray for this man

label: The virus dies on the boat and does not spread over Europe
description: A declaration taking authority over the virus, that it dies on that boat immediately and will not spread any further over Europe, with the blood applied over Europe.
aliases: it dies on that boat right now
it will not spread anymore over Europe

label: Five reptilian lineages, one on each continent
description: Five different reptilian races seen, one each in Asia, North America, Europe and Africa and others beyond, with each lineage looking different from the next. The one in Saudi Arabia is described as unlike the one in England, and the one around Mexico and South America as a bird lizard.
aliases: I saw five different reptilian races
each lineage looked different than the other fallen angel stuff
Look like a bird lizard thing

label: The flood came to stop the corruption of the human bloodline
description: That the Lord warned about giants upon the land and that the flood came because they were trying to destroy the pure human bloodline, with angels sleeping with women producing giants.
aliases: the Lord warned us about giants upon the land
they were trying to destroy the bloodline of pure human
angels sleeping with the women

label: A sitting member of Congress addresses a pastors' meeting by speakerphone
description: A sitting and powerful member of Congress calling into a meeting held only for pastors in Missouri and asking on speakerphone whether the pastors were listening to him. He says he got chills because it happened.
aliases: this sitting powerful member of Congress said, Are the pastors listening to me?
that was just for pastors

label: Will they release all of it
description: A question about how the nations will handle the deception when it manifests, framed as concerning not just America but Europe and other nations, with what he calls the beasts of Africa, and asking whether they will release all of it.
aliases: how will they handle it?
Will they release all of it

aliases: these are strategic people on the internet
